source.author: pankaj4u4m
source.text: I am open-sourcing a lightweight tool designed to help when you run out of GitHub runner quota. If your CI pipelines frequently hit their limits, this allows you to leverage your desktop's spare resources: https://github.com/olaryn-lab/ci-lifeboat
source.title: Show HN: CI-Lifeboat – Offload GitHub Action runners to your desktop
